content: Ravi Menon emailed Meera Chauhan regarding the reinstatement of her cancelled health policy (Policy #HP-DC-2026-0045), detailing that it requires clearing an outstanding premium of ₹12,300 and a ₹2,500 reinstatement fee (total ₹14,800), along with submitting a signed Reinstatement Form. Meera replied asking if the reinstatement fee is mandatory despite paying the full premium and whether she can split the payment into two installments.

action_items: Clarify if the reinstatement fee is mandatory
Confirm if payment can be split into two installments
Await customer's signed form and payment
